 LIVE Updated 30 mins ago Coventry City v Fulham live updates and team news from the CBS Arena
 Coventry City matchday blog from CoventryLive as Sky Blues reporter Andy Turner brings you live updates from the CBS Arena
 Frank Lampard manager of Coventry City 
 Add to preferred sources Comments Sport Andy Turner Coventry City reporter Updated 14:06, 24 Oct 2026 Coventry City entertain Fulham this afternoon as Frank Lampard's men attempt to get back to winning ways following Monday's defeat at Tottenham Hotspur.
 The Sky Blues recorded back-to-back victories prior to the trip to Spurs, including a confidence boosting 4-1 verdict over Newcastle United on home soil.
 Lampard has no new injuries to his squad which continues to be without striker Haji Wright who continues to recover from a quad injury from the summer, with the USA international due back next month. Elsewhere, midfielder Josh Eccles remains out with an ankle injury, having only just recovered from a calf strain.
 The big question on many fans' minds is whether or not French wingers Loum Tchaouna and Yann Gboho will be involved against The Cottagers after being left out altogether earlier in the week, and Tchaouna previously against the Magpies.
 Stay tuned for all today's team news which will be published here at 1.45pm, while Sky Blues reporter Andy Turner will provide live updates of all the action from 3pm.

 Today 13:00 BST Lampard explains Tchaouna and Gboho's absence from matchday squads
 Frank Lampard insists there’s no “drama” behind the omission of summer signings Loum Tchaouna and Yann Gboho from Coventry City ’s matchday squad.
 The French forwards, who signed for the Sky Blues for a combined £30m just a few short months ago, were conspicuous by their absence on the teamsheet at Tottenham on Monday night, while Tchaouna also didn’t feature in the previous squad against Newcastle United when Gboho was an unused sub.
 Neither are injured amid rumours of sulking and turning up late for training. But asked about their situation, Lampard explained: “They’re training and they’re fit and I think they’re adapting to how we are, how we play, how we train and the ideas, so it’s very normal.
 “Yann came in on the last day of the transfer window, even beyond that because it was protracted for a few more days. He also went over to the Ivory Coast on international duty, which is great. But the players have been working in a certain way for a long time here and Yann has adapted fine. He’s got talent, that’s for sure, and that’s that. I have a squad to pick and sometimes it’s not easy to pick. It’s the hardest part of my job.”

 Comments Andy Turner Today 13:00 BST Lampard on City star with best defensive stats in Prem
 Coventry City defender Bobby Thomas currently boasts the most clearances and defensive actions by any Premier League player so far this season.
 Those stats back up one of the Sky Blues ’ early season success stories of a player who has stepped up from the Championship and is seemingly growing in stature with every game that goes, looking every bit a top flight performer. Asked about the centre-back’s character and career trajectory, Frank Lampard said: “Yeah, it’s been great to be a part of it, too, in our time as staff at the club to see Bobby who was always a centre-back with lots of potential, lots of character when you get to know him you see a willingness to get better, and we try to help him.
 “But more than that, he’s helped himself because I think he’s really focussed on becoming this player that we’re now seeing. I’ve got a good relationship with him; we have as a staff. He’s easy to engage with and there’s something about his demeanour and his ways as a leader in the team, and I think he’s even improved that side of it off the pitch and around the dressing room where he’s worked hard on his own game.”
